name: Dreamera: Figment of Dreams
description:
About This Game

Dreamera: Figment of dreams
Figment I – Chaos

Dreamers is a point-and-click adventure set inside a surreal network of fairy dreams.

You play as a young Pixie, freshly hired as a “Dream Janitor,” tasked with maintaining the fragile dreamworlds of the sleeping fairy sisters. Each dream is a living world, beautiful, strange, and governed by its own logic. When a shadowy force begins spreading chaos, you are pulled inside… and the Dreamgate mysteriously shatters behind you.

Trapped between worlds, you must explore interconnected dream realms, solve intricate environmental puzzles, and uncover the truth behind a forgotten past sealed away long ago.

Explore Interconnected Dream Worlds

Travel between handcrafted dream environments using the Dreamgate, a mysterious portal that connects the dreams. Each dream follows its own internal rules, from whimsical underground villages to rigid chess kingdoms and sterile bureaucratic machine worlds, yet all are subtly linked.

Objects, creatures, and consequences carry across dreams. What you disturb in one world may echo in another.

Puzzle-Driven Adventure

Dreamera blends classic point-and-click logic with modern escape-room design:

  • Environmental puzzles and multi-step interactions

  • Inventory-based problem solving

  • Pattern recognition, sequences, logic grids, and spatial riddles

  • Optional hint system that respects player curiosity

Puzzles are grounded in narrative context and every solution reveals more about the world, its inhabitants, and the forces manipulating you.

A Story Told Through Dreams

The narrative unfolds organically through exploration, environmental storytelling, and strange encounters with dream folk.

As the truth emerges, you’ll question who is helping whom and whether restoring balance comes at a terrible cost.

Themes include:

  • Forgotten memories

  • Control versus freedom

  • Healing, acceptance, and unintended consequences

Features

  • First-person point-and-click adventure

  • Escape-room inspired puzzle design

  • Surreal dream worlds with distinct visual identities

  • The Dreamgate: a central mechanic for traversal and mystery

  • Narrative-driven gameplay with twists and foreshadowing

  • Atmospheric sound design and original music

  • Chapter-based structure with cinematic intros and cliffhangers

A Living Dream Series

Dreamera: Figment I – Chaos is the first chapter in a planned narrative trilogy.

Each chapter expands the world, deepens the mystery, and recontextualizes what you thought you understood.
short_desc: Point-and-click puzzle adventure about exploring surreal dream worlds, solving layered environmental puzzles, and navigating between realities through a central Dreamgate.
